content.title: Traffic restrictions and diversions in Banjara Hills
content.caption: Traffic restrictions and diversions are implemented in Banjara Hills due to the ongoing construction of a steel flyover.

slides.heading: Traffic restrictions and diversions in Banjara Hills
slides.text: Traffic restrictions and diversions are implemented in Banjara Hills due to the ongoing construction of a steel flyover.

slides.heading: Construction of Steel Flyover
slides.text: A steel flyover between Jubilee Hills Check Post and NFCL under the H-CITI project is under construction.

slides.heading: Traffic Restrictions
slides.text: Traffic restrictions are implemented on stretches between Srinagar Colony T-Junction and NTR Bhavan on Road No. 2, Banjara Hills.
